title: Love for Love: A Comedy
author: William Congreve
description: "Love for Love: A Comedy by William Congreve" is a Restoration comedy written in 1695.
longDescription: Valentine, a young man drowning in debt, signs away his inheritance to escape his creditors and win his father's help.

authorInfo.bio: William Congreve (1670–1729) wrote Love for Love: A Comedy. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
